how.title: How it works
how.intro: Draft ten players, stay under the cap, then see how far they go.
how.spinB: Each round lands on a random NBA team-season. Pick one player from it.
how.rosterB: Fill PG, SG, SF, PF and C, plus five bench spots. Some players can play two positions.
how.capB: Every player costs his real contract, scaled to that season's cap. Rookie deals are cheap; max and supermax deals aren't. The game always keeps enough room for you to fill every spot. Today's modes use a $200M cap. Each Time Machine era uses its own real cap and that era's dollars (Magic vs. Bird: the 1987-88 cap of $6.2M), so a star costs what he really took of the cap then.
how.rulesB: At most two players rated 95 or higher. One free respin per draft. If a spin has nobody you can fit, you get the cheapest player who does.
how.seasonB: Injuries cost the games they say. At game 50 you get one trade at the deadline. Watch it game by game or skip ahead.
how.playoffsB: The top 6 in each conference are in; 7 to 10 play in. Best-of-7 series, game by game. 70 wins is rare. 82-0 is a myth.
how.challengeB: After a run, share your link. Whoever opens it gets the same spins and the same league: the real teams. If someone drafts a player off a team, that team plays without him and its bench steps up, so your picks are the only difference.
how.divB: Choose your conference and division before tip-off. You play the whole league either way; the playoffs are seeded inside each conference.
how.squadB: Your ten players as one number. Starters count most, 15% each; the bench counts 9, 6, 5, 3 and 2% from your 6th man to your 10th. The higher it is, the more you win: about 66 wins at 87, about 75 at 91. Only an elite squad can go 82-0.
how.packsB: Every finished season earns a pack, a better one at 60+ wins. Reach the conference finals or further for a second pack that gets better the deeper you go, up to the Ultimate Pick (98+ cards only) for 82-0 and 16-0. One power-up a day, and never more than one on the same pack.

holdout.title: Holdout
holdout.rule: Pay him ({{amount}}) or he sits 5 games.

superteam-rumor.title: Superteam rumor

team-chemistry.title: Team chemistry
team-chemistry.story: {{coach}} took the team on a bonding trip, and it shows.

board.pickHintObjective: Six face-down cards, each one a mission from the board. The card you flip is the objective you must complete.

rebuild.title: Takeover
rebuild.desc: Buy a real team with its real payroll and a rebuild budget. The board gives you one objective to complete by tip-off. Pick a coach, then go position by position: keep the player, or sell him and sign one of three priced options or a bench option.
rebuild.pickTeam: Pick a team to take over
rebuild.budgetDesc: Selling a player adds his contract to the budget. Signing one spends it.
rebuild.coachDesc: Keep the coach, or fire him and hire one of three.

offense.name: Offense guru
offense.desc: +3 team rating for the first half of the season, +1 after.

rebuild.openDemands: The board will check these from tip-off on:
rebuild.hubADesc: Draft ten in any mode, pick your objective, and survive one midseason card.
rebuild.hubBDesc: Buy a real team and rebuild it your way, position by position.

dynasty.title: Dynasty
dynasty.desc: Pick a franchise. Keep its real roster, or hold a fantasy draft: spin your slot and all 30 teams draft today's league from scratch. Then build a dynasty, season after season.
dynasty.bannerDesc: Pick a franchise: its real roster or a 30-team fantasy draft. Then season after season, with players who grow, peak and retire.
dynasty.howStart: How do you want to start the {{team}}?
dynasty.realDesc: This season's team, as it is. Start playing right away.
dynasty.draftDesc: Spin for your draft slot. All 30 teams draft today's league from scratch: 10 rounds, snake order.
dynasty.spinDesc: Slot 1 picks first. The order snakes: whoever picks last in a round picks first in the next.

partyTk.createHint: Everyone takes over the same real team and rebuilds it at once: same options, 3-2-1 reveals, bidding wars.
partyTk.lobbyDesc: Same roster, same budget. Rebuild it position by position; whoever builds best wins the season.
partyTk.budget: Budget {{budget}} · up to {{max}} for this spot
partyTk.bidIn: Bid in. Waiting for the others…
partyTk.warHint: Bid blind: at least {{min}}, at most {{max}}. The top bid signs him at that price.
partyTk.err: That didn't go through. Try again.
